verify.name: Verify
verify.desc: Check the supplier's company record (KYB) before any money is committed.

escrow.name: Escrow
escrow.desc: Funds are locked in milestone escrow, not sent straight to the supplier.
escrow.thumb2: Released in tranches as milestones are met.

check.name: Check
check.desc: Documents are cross-checked and scanned for forgery and hidden instructions.
check.thumb2: The document tried to give an order. It was treated as data and flagged.

release.name: Release

features.title: Everything a small importer needs
features.lead: Seven tools, one safety model. Each one opens in the demo.

financing.name: Financing matching
financing.desc: Compare supplier credit, bank and escrow-backed options for one order.

cashflow.name: Cash-flow alerts
cashflow.desc: Weekly forecast that warns you before a payment would leave you short.

analysis.name: Financial analysis
analysis.desc: Landed cost, margin and break-even for each order, calculated by code.

forensics.name: Document forensics
forensics.desc: Spot edited invoices, duplicate documents and hidden instructions.

risk.name: Risk tiers & approvals
risk.desc: Four tiers decide who must approve, from automatic to code plus cooling-off.

cny.name: CNY settlement
cny.desc: Suppliers are paid in RMB with the exchange rate shown up front.

chat.name: Bangla/Chinese chat
chat.desc: Ask in Bangla, English or Chinese. The assistant explains; code does the maths.

security.title: Five layers between a lie and your money
security.lead: The model explains; deterministic code enforces. Try to break each layer yourself.

risk.name: Risk engine
risk.desc: Every money action gets a tier from fixed rules, not from a prompt.

approvals.name: Approvals + OTP
approvals.desc: Only a human endpoint can execute. Tier 3 adds a code and a 10-minute cooling-off.

privacy.name: Privacy gateway
privacy.desc: Account numbers, IDs and names are masked before any model sees them.

injection.name: Injection defence
injection.desc: Text inside documents and emails is data. Instructions hidden there are flagged.

audit.name: Signed audit log
audit.desc: Hash-chained and signed. Anyone can verify it in the browser.

security.tiersLead: Each tier has an icon and a label, never colour alone.

a11y.title: Accessibility statement
a11y.intro: We aim for WCAG 2.2 level AA on every public page of Setu. This statement says what we have actually checked and what we have not.
a11y.updated: Last updated: 20 October 2026. This is a self-assessment, not an independent audit.

status.title: Conformance status
status.body: Setu is designed to meet WCAG 2.2 AA but has not been formally audited. We claim partial, self-assessed conformance only.

checked.title: What is built in
checked.c1: Pages use landmarks (header, nav, main, footer), one h1 per page and ordered headings.
checked.c2: Interactive elements are real buttons and links with visible focus rings and touch targets of at least 44 px.
checked.c3: Status is never shown by colour alone: tiers and badges always carry an icon and a text label.
checked.c4: Animations and auto-advancing carousels respect the reduced-motion setting, pause on hover and focus, and have a pause button.
checked.c5: Light and dark themes use colour pairs chosen to reach 4.5:1 text contrast; language can be switched between English, Bangla and Chinese.

pending.title: What is not yet verified
pending.p1: Automated checks: in this release an axe-core scan (WCAG 2.0/2.1 A and AA) was run by hand over the landing page, dashboard, deals list, a deal, approvals, the demo page and the demo runner, in English, Bangla and Chinese, light and dark, at 1440 px and 360 px. It found one serious issue (a scrollable message list that keyboards could not reach), which is fixed. No CI pipeline enforces it yet.
pending.p2: An automated check found no horizontal overflow at 360 px on those pages. A full manual keyboard-only walkthrough of every page is still planned, not completed.
pending.p3: Screen-reader testing (NVDA, VoiceOver, TalkBack) has not been done.
pending.p4: Colour contrast has been designed for, but not independently measured on every screen.

limits.title: Known limitations
limits.l1: Bangla and Chinese text has not been reviewed by native speakers and may contain errors.
limits.l2: Some charts and the animated hero preview are decorative and carry a text description instead.
limits.l3: Documents shown in the demo are generated sample PDFs and may not be fully tagged for screen readers.
limits.l4: The Chinese interface is available on public pages first; some app screens may still show English.
